title: PlaneMem legacy context index management
description: Complete successes for directory, current status, explicit index content write, delete and restore. Mutation receipts are historical metadata, index writes return saved content, and current status has separate identity/permission hints. No saved ContextItem or ContextPack is created.
$comment: Source-only. Locally register this schema and search.json with IDs/relative paths preserved. Existing runtime additionally checks UTF-16 lengths, lone surrogates where noted, finite dates/canonical roundtrips, same scope/request/identity, status-time arithmetic, expected_revision+1, and cursor bindings. New schemas have not been integrated into runtime/SDK/Mock or executed.

manualId.description: Case-sensitive plane: prefix is event-managed and cannot be indexed, deleted or restored through these commands.

identityText.$comment: Runtime rejects lone surrogates and >1024 UTF-16 units. Leading/trailing whitespace is allowed and preserved; no identifier trimming.

requestKey.$comment: validateIdempotencyKey requires 1..255 UTF-16 units without whitespace. It does not independently reject all other control characters or lone surrogates; actual HTTP header and PostgreSQL storage can further constrain representations.

reason.$comment: Check raw <=2000 UTF-16 units/no NUL/no lone surrogates then trim. Other controls are not separately rejected.

time.$comment: Finite Date.parse with exact toISOString roundtrip, four-digit year only; real calendar validation remains runtime. Database date/string values are first converted to UTC milliseconds.

identity.description: Current authenticated context identity in status success, not an authorization credential or a promise that future writes succeed. Read can use fallback client identity; write hint separately requires authenticated_client.

status.description: Metadata only; no title/snippet/source_refs. Runtime requires updated_at<=checked_at and nonnull deleted_at<=checked_at. Deletion wins over expiry; otherwise expires_at<=checked_at means expired, else active. Classification is the index record's own value. checked_at is read-time or original mutation-time, not a source-freshness or upstream observation proof.

statusQuery.description: Shared input; HTTP id comes from decoded path, with no URL query.

query.$comment: Raw <=500 UTF-16 units and no lone surrogates, then trim; empty/whitespace-only allowed. Matches ID only through PostgreSQL lower/strpos.

listQuery.description: Decoded query. Omitted fields default; null is invalid. Each HTTP name appears once; wire limit is 1..3 decimal digits without leading zero, then checked<=100. Cursor binds normalized query/state/managed_by/scope/restricted flag, not limit/actor/client.

listPage.description: No query/limit echo, total or has_more. Runtime requires distinct IDs, common scope, requested state/managed_by, items<=limit and full page with changed cursor when next_cursor present. SQL orders ID COLLATE C and filters before limit+1, parses only selected metadata; lookahead is not separately parsed. Shared page parser does not check ordering, text-match or equal checked_at. One materialized database clock is used for SQL filter/metadata, comparing expiry at millisecond precision. Missing/hidden parent gives empty200.

x-cursor.limits: Not signed, not authorization or cross-page snapshot; changing limit or actor/client alone does not invalidate it. Decode checks full canonical encoding; new cursor is emitted only with lookahead.

id.description: Optional raw HTTP field, overwritten by decoded route ID before parsing; no equality check against path, even for a different JSON type.

mutationBody.description: Supply request key in header or body; if both exist they must be identical. Body expected_revision is always required and must equal any parsed version header. Path must be a manual ID. No scope or identity override.

mutation.description: Normalized command fingerprint is SHA256(JSON.stringify({id,expected_revision,reason})) in this property order. Original request key and identity are separate; body reason is trimmed only after raw validation.

mutationReceipt.description: Exact original operation/key/normalized reason/expected revision and record ID/scope. record.revision=expected_revision+1; record dates are historical and replay does not refresh checked_at. Restore does not change expiry/title/snippet/sources/classification. No replayed flag, original trace, receipt ID or event/cursor is returned.

title.$comment: Raw UTF-16 length<=1000, no NUL/lone surrogate. Nonblank but not trimmed.

snippet.$comment: Raw UTF-16 length<=65536, no NUL/lone surrogate. Nonblank but not trimmed.

score.description: Any finite number, not constrained to0..1; normalized ranking is computed later by search.

expires_at.$comment: Finite Date.parse and trailing Z, then toISOString. Extended years accepted by this write parser; management status requires four-digit years. No future-date requirement.

writeBody.description: Initial write may use revision0; replacing an existing active or expired record requires strictly higher revision and nondecreasing classification. Source extensions are dropped during normalization; order retained. Configured capture requires <=63 sources on fresh write, even if optional; saved replay bypasses this slot check. Both header/body keys must agree. Version headers are parsed but not used for index CAS or fingerprint; expected_version/expected_revision body fields are not accepted.

writtenHit.description: Normalized original content/score/rank/classification/expiry plus public sources, optionally one appended {type:ai-memory,id:page_ref}. Capture only checks scope and nonempty string page_ref, not record-ID/URI/hash/revision validity. Does not include capture failure/degraded/replayed flags or database updated_at. Historical replay returns the same saved hit after current/receipt visibility/expiry checks.

statusEnvelope.description: index_identity scope equals data scope. write=true requires verified client and admin role or context.write, independently of record state, plane prefix or future authorization; it is not permission to edit a Plane record. SDK parses data/scope but generic envelope reader does not validate these two extra fields.

writeEnvelope.description: Outer sources exactly equal returned hit sources in order. Current outer trace, no inner trace or original event/replay metadata.

mutationEnvelope.description: Current outer trace with historical metadata receipt. No outer revision/etag/cursor, no ETag, no content or event emission.
